text: SoftBank Vision Fund gains became predominantly linked to OpenAI valuation expansion while losses persisted across other portfolio positions. Asset sales, debt concerns, and liquidity management activity coexisted with increased capital commitment toward a single AI entity. Portfolio performance and financing stability occupied increasingly asymmetric dependency states centered on OpenAI exposure.

meta.note: Concentration and contingency overlapped because portfolio stability remained partially dependent on external valuation persistence.

text: Alibaba increased capital and operational allocation toward AI chips, cloud infrastructure, and rapid-commerce systems while core profitability sharply declined. Revenue acceleration concentrated within AI-linked cloud services as broader e-commerce margins weakened under sustained investment intensity. Internal resource deployment increasingly centered on compute supply, AI services, and integrated platform expansion.

meta.note: Compression and expansion operated simultaneously across different operational layers of the same corporate structure.
